text:
emily: FYI: midweek quiet window tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll run two ops canaries: routing-policy:v2 (eu-west) and quant-tuner:v1.3 (us-east). Full train freeze during window; ops canaries allowed. Plan: https://go.redwood/midweek-quiet :calendar:

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance start=2026-04-02T02:00:00Z end=2026-04-02T05:00:00Z. routing-policy:v2 canary @02:10 UTC pct=3% (eu-west). quant-tuner:v1.3 canary @02:30 UTC pct=2% (us-east).

oncall-ops: Pager thresholds: error_rate >0.04 OR latency_p95 +1s above baseline. Will increase trace sampling during canaries.

jim: Dedicated pools? Two pinned accounts might be affected.

emily: Dedicated excluded by default; owners must post in #release-exempt to opt-in. Liaison will confirm.

nina: Rollback triggers for routing-policy?v2?

emily: Rollback if 5xxs >50% sustained 3m OR routing_mismatch_pct >0.2%. Pause expansion if latency_p95 >25% above baseline for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary started routing-policy:v2 eu-west at 2026-04-02T02:10:12Z pct=3.

oncall-ops: Observed routing_mismatch_pct to 0.18% (baseline 0.03%) for ~3m. Holding expansion.

emily: hold and investigate. Nina, lia, grab traces for that window.

nina: traces collected, sending link.

platform-bot: Investigation suggests header-normalization change in v2. Patch queued.

lia: validated patch in staging. Recommend apply to canary.

emily: apply patch and keep pct at 3% until stable.

deploy-bot: Patch applied at 2026-04-02T02:45:00Z.

oncall-ops: mismatch dropped to 0.04% within 4m after patch.

emily: proceed to expand routing-policy:v2 to 15% in eu at +30m. Quant-tuner paused until routing stable.

jim: updating runbook with patch steps.

emily: lifting partial freeze for docs/infra cleanup at 03:00 UTC. Full train freeze lifted at 05:00 UTC as planned. Will post short blameless writeup tomorrow.

oncall-ops: No pages during expansion. Final canary status: routing-policy:v2 SUCCESS, final_mismatch=0.03%.

deploy-bot: Maintenance window completed at 2026-04-02T05:00:10Z.

emily: If teams want raw metrics or traces, ping me. Thanks everyone.
